submitList.sortHint: Quantity sorts on the last known count, so rows stay put while you type.
submitList.hiddenEntries: {count} item(s) you entered are hidden by the search — all of them are still included when you submit.

login.title: Inventory Management
login.subtitle: Demo login — pick a user to impersonate. (Entra ID sign-in replaces this in production.)
login.accessHelp: Access is granted by your administrator. If you cannot sign in, ask them to check your account.
login.demoDesc: This list is not shown in production. Set AUTH_PROVIDER=entra to hide it locally.

magic.label: Grower or vendor? Sign in with your email
magic.sentBody: If {email} is registered, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 15 minutes and can only be used once.
magic.error: Something went wrong sending that link. Try again, or contact your administrator if it keeps happening.

error.title: Could not sign you in
error.config: Microsoft sign-in is not configured on this environment. Contact your administrator.
error.entra: Microsoft rejected the sign-in. Contact your administrator if this continues.
error.state: That sign-in attempt expired or did not match. Please try again.
error.nocode: Microsoft did not return a sign-in code. Please try again.
error.noidentity: Microsoft did not return an identity we could match. Contact your administrator.
error.unprovisioned: That account does not have access to this app. Ask an administrator to add you, or sign in with a different account.
error.nolink: That sign-in link was incomplete. Request a new one below.
error.linkexpired: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
error.mailfailed: We could not send the sign-in email. Please try again in a moment.
error.sessionexpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
error.partnerdisabled: Your organization's access to this app has been disabled. Contact your administrator.

form.title: Submit inventory
form.description: Record today's on-hand counts and manage orders. Save a draft anytime; numbers only count once you submit.
form.noItems: No items are authorized for your grower yet. Ask an admin to authorize items.
form.loadPreviousHint: Most counts don't change day to day — start from your last submitted values and edit what moved.
form.weekChangeTitle: Change vs the same item a week ago
form.locationHint: Counts are recorded against the selected location.
form.noLocations: No locations are mapped to your grower yet. Ask an admin to map at least one location before submitting counts.
form.incompleteTitle: Not every item has a count
form.incompleteBody: You haven't completed all items: {done} of {total} have a quantity. Are you sure you want to submit? If you don't have any of an item, enter 0.

orders.heading: Orders
orders.noVendors: No vendors mapped to this item.
orders.cancelDesc: Cancel this order from {vendor}? It won't count as received.

actions.notAuthorized: You're not authorized for this item.
actions.invalidVendor: Choose a valid vendor for this item.
actions.alreadyClosed: That order is no longer open.
actions.deliveryTooSoon: {vendor} needs at least {days} day(s) from the order date. The earliest delivery date is {date}.
actions.deliveryBeforeOrder: The delivery date can't be before the order date.
actions.orderDateFuture: The order date can't be in the future.

orders.receivedHint: Prefilled with what you ordered — change it only if something is off.
orders.receiptNoteHint: Ignored when the quantity matches what was ordered.
orders.orderDateHint: Today, or earlier if you placed it before entering it here.
orders.leadTimeHint: {vendor} needs at least {days} day(s), so the earliest is {date}.
orders.vendorDateNote: The vendor has confirmed delivery for {date}.

requests.title: Missing item requests
requests.description: Request items you need that aren't in your authorized list.
requests.dialogDesc: An admin will review and may add it to your list.

actions.draftSaved: Draft saved ({count} item(s)). Submit to record them.
actions.noItems: Enter at least one item quantity first.
actions.noAuthorized: No authorized items in this submission.
actions.locationNotAllowed: That location is not mapped to your grower.

flagHistory.title: Flag history
flagHistory.description: Every time you turned on "Low" for an item, and how it ended.

items.title: My items
items.description: Everything you're authorized to count, what you hold at each location, and what's on order.

form.title: Submit supply report
form.description: Report the quantity you have for each item, and optionally break it down per grower.
form.over: Allocated total exceeds the item quantity.
form.overBlocked: {count} item(s) allocate more than they report — fix them before submitting.
form.noItems: No items are mapped to your vendor yet. Ask an admin to map items.
form.loadPreviousHint: Most reports don't change week to week — start from your last reported quantities and grower allocations, and edit what moved.

history.title: Report history
history.description: Your past supply reports and grower allocations.

actions.noItems: Enter at least one item quantity first.
actions.noSupplied: No supplied items in this submission.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Orders growers have placed with you. Confirm a delivery date for each: the grower is told, and delivery is measured against it.
orders.leadTimeHint: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this many days after the order date. Leave blank for no minimum.
orders.leadTimeExplain: Growers can't request delivery sooner than this after their order date.

actions.closed: That order is no longer open.
actions.beforeOrder: The delivery date can't be before the order date.
actions.confirmed: Delivery date confirmed. The grower has been notified.
actions.changed: Delivery date changed. The grower has been notified.
actions.leadTimeInvalid: Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 365.

items.title: My items
items.description: Everything you supply, your latest reported stock, and how you ship each item (your conversions).
items.chainHint: How you pack this item for shipping. It never changes an ordered quantity.
items.noChainsDefined: No conversion chain is defined for {category} yet. Ask an administrator to add one.
items.ratiosHint: Comma-separated, innermost first: how many {base} fit in the first level, then how many of those in the next.

email.footer: Automated message from the Inventory Management system. Please do not reply to this email.

submissionReceived.subject: Inventory submission received — {grower} ({location})
submissionReceived.heading: Inventory submission received
submissionReceived.intro: A daily inventory count was just submitted for {grower} by {submittedBy}.

vendorSubmissionReceived.subject: Supply report received — {vendor}
vendorSubmissionReceived.heading: Supply report received
vendorSubmissionReceived.intro: A supply report was just submitted for {vendor} by {submittedBy}.

scheduledReminder.subject: Reminder: submit your inventory count — {grower}
scheduledReminder.heading: Time to submit your inventory count
scheduledReminder.intro: {grower} has not submitted an inventory count in {overdue}. Please update your on-hand counts so stock stays accurate.

missingItemRequest.subject: New item request — {grower}
missingItemRequest.heading: New item request
missingItemRequest.intro: {requestedBy} at {grower} requested a new item to be added to their authorized list.

requestReviewed.subject: Your item request was reviewed — {item}
requestReviewed.heading: Your item request was reviewed
requestReviewed.intro: Your request for "{item}" has been reviewed and is now marked {status}.

lowInventoryReviewed.subject: Low-inventory flag reviewed — {item}
lowInventoryReviewed.heading: Low-inventory flag reviewed
lowInventoryReviewed.intro: An admin has reviewed the low-inventory flag you raised for "{item}". It has been cleared from your list.

orderPlaced.subject: Order placed — {item}
orderPlaced.heading: Order placed
orderPlaced.intro: Your order for "{item}" has been placed with {vendor}.

magicLink.subject: Your sign-in link
magicLink.heading: Sign in to Inventory Management
magicLink.intro: Use the button below to sign in. No password needed.
magicLink.expiry: This link expires in {minutes} minutes and can only be used once. If you did not request it, you can ignore this email.

vendorOrderPlaced.subject: New order to confirm — {item} for {grower}
vendorOrderPlaced.heading: New order: please confirm a delivery date
vendorOrderPlaced.intro: {grower} placed an order with {vendor} for {item}. Please confirm the date you can deliver it.

orderConfirmed.subject: Delivery date confirmed — {item}
orderConfirmed.heading: Delivery date confirmed
orderConfirmed.intro: {vendor} confirmed delivery of your order for {item} on {date}.

orderDateChanged.subject: Delivery date changed — {item}
orderDateChanged.heading: Delivery date changed
orderDateChanged.intro: {vendor} changed the delivery date of your order for {item} to {date} (it was {previous}).

conversions.mappingNotFound: That item mapping was not found.
conversions.cleared: Conversions cleared. This item ships in plain units.
conversions.chainNotFound: That conversion chain was not found.
conversions.wrongCategory: That chain belongs to category {chain}, but this item is in {item}.
conversions.levelCount: Enter one quantity per level: this chain has {count} ({levels}).
